summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with [start, stop] per dimension in the unpadded frame; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes; docstrings updated); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter patch generator delegating to iter_patch; GridPatchDataset reworked to take dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with per-patch transform via apply_transform map_items=False, worker partitioning via np.ceil, NotImplementedError when no len(); math import removed; PatchDataset docstring uses float); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset; tests/test_grid_dataset.py added with TestGridPatchDataset (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus default-coordinates and no-len tests). Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified. Multi-worker check in test_loading_array uses a transform-free dataset to keep values deterministic, a deviation from the spec's RandShiftIntensity wording. Docstring example shows shapes only. No commits made.
